type app.Chart {from int64; to int64; stepMs int64; times []int64; values []*float64; avg *float64; min *float64; max *float64; usv []*float64; avgUSv *float64; minUSv *float64; maxUSv *float64; attentionCPM int; attentionUSv float64; alarmCPM int; alarmUSv float64; dangerCPM int; dangerUSv float64; peaks []app.ChartPeak; fineAlertsOnly bool; rc []*float64; rcAvg *float64; rcCPM []*float64; rcAvgCPM *float64}
type app.ChartPeak {t int64; cpm float64; level string; retro bool}
type app.CloudDevice {id string; name string; lastUp int64; me bool}
type app.CloudInfo {state string; ready bool; email string; lastSync int64; queue []string; used int64; devices []app.CloudDevice; auto bool; skewSec int; dupOf string; sendNow string; sendI int; sendN int; err string; removed int64; restart bool; restarted int64; vaultWait bool}
type app.CloudLoginDone {info app.CloudInfo; next string; lastUp int64}
type app.DevLive {connected bool; state string; since int64; last int64; lastGood int64; countsOffline bool}
type app.Event {id int64; time int64; text string; kind string; level string; cpm float64; peak float64; peakAt int64; end int64; retro bool; active bool; demo bool; device string; endReason string; usv float64; peakUSv float64; usvPerCPM float64}
type app.LogBucket {t int64; counts map[string]int}
type app.LogComp {name string; count int}
type app.LogEntry {t int64; level string; comp string; msg string}
type app.LogQuery {from int64; to int64; levels []string; comp string; text string; limit int}
type app.LogResult {entries []app.LogEntry; total int; counts map[string]int; comps []app.LogComp; buckets []app.LogBucket; bucketMs int64; from int64; to int64}
type app.Period {id int64; from int64; to int64; name string; gmc string; radiacode string; notHome bool; planned int64; estimated bool; uid string; edited int64}
type app.RcLimits {attn float64; alarm float64; danger float64; device bool}
type app.RcSettings {(embutido) radiacode.Settings; canUndo bool; undoAt string}
type app.RcState {state string; via string; model string; serial string; firmware string; err string; ble string; bleOK bool; off bool; time int64; cps float64; cpsErr float64; usvh float64; usvhErr float64; dose float64; doseSec int64; battery float64; tempC float64; hasRare bool; alarms *radiacode.AlarmLimits; since int64; today float64; todayDev float64; todayDevOK bool; lastT int64; lastUSv float64; lastCPS float64; stats *app.RcStats; attnUSv float64; alarmUSv float64; dangerUSv float64; alertLevel string; limits app.RcLimits; doseLive float64; doseLiveSec float64; doseLiveAt int64; offscale bool; doseLiveOn bool}
type app.RcStats {bgUSv float64; bgLo float64; bgHi float64; bgMinutes int; avg1h float64; n1h int; min24h float64; max24h float64; max24hAt int64; n24h int; todayMinutes int}
type app.Settings {port string; portUsb string; autoConnect bool; alarmEnabled bool; alarmCPM int; alarmUSv float64; alarmSound string; alarmRaise bool; attentionEnabled bool; rainEnabled bool; rainLat float64; rainLon float64; rainPlace string; rainHidePlace bool; levels levels.Levels; awayAskMin int; trayOnClose bool; trayPlain bool; trayDevice string; uiScale float64; uiDensity string; pulseOff bool; pulseStrip bool; pulseLogo string; bgMoved int64; startWithWindows bool; noUpdateCheck bool; skipVersion string; keepOldVersions bool; syncListen bool; noSyncAuto bool; lang string; rcOff bool; rcBLE string; noMeasureReport bool; noAutoHistory bool; reportDir string; reportMode string; reportNotes bool; reportNoCfg bool; usageOn bool}
type app.Whereabouts {gmc string; radiacode string; normal bool; personal string; home string; since int64; notHome bool; open *app.Period; live map[string]app.DevLive}
type levels.Levels {attentionCPM int; dangerCPM int; attentionUSv float64; dangerUSv float64; snoozeMin int; satMaxUSv float64; satDropUSv float64; satHoldSec int; rcSatUSv float64; deadTimeOn bool; deadTimeUs float64}
type radiacode.AlarmLimits {CountRate1 float64; CountRate2 float64; DoseRate1 float64; DoseRate2 float64; Dose1 float64; Dose2 float64; ShowSv bool; ShowCPM bool}
type radiacode.BLEDevice {address string; name string; rssi int; paired bool}
type radiacode.Settings {doseRate1 float64; doseRate2 float64; dose1 float64; dose2 float64; countRate1 float64; countRate2 float64; soundOn bool; soundCtrl uint32; vibroOn bool; vibroCtrl uint32; brightness int; offTime int; offTimes []string; direction int; unitSv bool; unitCPM bool; energyA0 float64; energyA1 float64; energyA2 float64}
